gloss_text: Someone rang the front door bell. Do you want to watch the video or answer through the speaker?
A delivery person is at the gate and has already rung twice. They are waiting for your confirmation.
Your expected visitor, Cláudia, has arrived at the gate. Do you want me to release the entrance?
A parcel arrived for flat 302 and is at the concierge desk. You can pick it up until 6pm.
The internet technician is at reception for flat 5A and needs approval in the app.
A visitor, Mr Bruno, is waiting in the lobby of block C. He said he was invited to dinner. Do you want me to let him up?
Transcript: Hi, it's me. Call me when you can about the restaurant on Saturday. No rush if it's late.
Transcript: Good afternoon, I am calling about your registration. Please call back during business hours.
Voice message from an unknown number: Hello, it is about your warranty. Can you call back during the week?
Transcript: Hi, it's Clara. I'm passing by the market tomorrow, do you want tomatoes? Reply when you can.
Transcript: I just wanted to say I'm happy about your new office. See you next week!
Voice message from +1 555-0148: Here is the agency, we will talk on Monday. No rush.
BTC rose 2.1% in the last 24 hours. See your portfolio summary in the app.
ETH reached the value you set. This is not a buy recommendation.
The crypto market closed the day slightly up. Check the main assets of the week.
Your stablecoin balance earned 0.4% this week. You can see the details in the app.
SOL fell below the value you set yesterday. Check the chart if you like.
The crypto exchange opened with low volume. No action is needed.
Live captions are turned off. Tap to turn them on again.
The Portuguese language pack was downloaded. Captions now work offline.
Live captions are paused during your video call.
The download of the caption language pack has finished.
Live captions: on-device processing turned on for this device.
The speech recognition model was updated. No action is needed.

Who's going to the beach on Sunday? I'll bring the cooler with water and ice 🧊, and Uncle Roberto says he'll bring the beach chair. We meet at 11am in the car park, and no being late this time! Sofia, can you bring the camera? We want photos for the year-end card.

Has anyone seen a grey striped cat near the square? It wears a blue collar and is very gentle. If you find it, let the fourth-floor flat know, please. And for anyone looking for a plumber: the one at the end of the street did a great job here yesterday, highly recommended.

Guys, the field bar opens at 9, so let's agree on the uniforms. I'm still in the red shirt, can someone bring the bibs? And Marcos, stop saying you scored the final goal, the video clearly shows who it was 😂

That Mario Kart tournament was so funny. Does anyone still have the replay? Let's do another round Thursday night if you're up for it. I found a new shortcut for the castle track, you need to try it before the next season starts, I'll show you before we begin.

Forwarded many times: good morning everyone, don't forget to share this message with ten people to bring luck to your family this week. Whoever doesn't will have bad luck for a whole month. Have a great day everyone 🌞

Forwarded: a rumour is going around that the canteen will close in January. Nobody has confirmed it and the school office has said nothing. Please don't pass it on without a source, but if anyone has proof, let us know before tomorrow so we can check with the headteacher.

I'm forwarding the picture I got early this morning: Good morning, a smile and a great day for you! with a steaming coffee and flowers. Send it to the people you love, it makes everyone happy. Thanks, neighbours, and good morning!

Condominium owners' meeting on Thursday at 7:30pm in the party room. Agenda: facade renovation, garden budget and choice of the new caretaker. Please confirm attendance by Tuesday night, there will be drinks and biscuits for everyone.

For the street party we are collecting R$ 15 per household for the barbecue and the sound system. Pix to João by the 30th. The party is on 14 July from 4pm on the little field behind the school. Bring your folding chairs!

Reminder: the start-of-year meeting is moved to Tuesday at 6pm, room 12. On the agenda: the calendar of school trips and the organisation of the year-end fair. Bring stall ideas, we will talk over coffee.

Smoke identified on the 3rd floor of block B. The firefighters are already on the way. Please leave by the courtyard emergency stairs, do not use the lift and only come back when the management says so. Stay calm and do not gather in groups.

Gas leak reported on Rua das Acácias, strong smell. Do not turn on lights or use a lighter, open the windows and leave the building now. Rescue workers are arriving, move away from the street and wait for instructions on site.

Flooding on Central Avenue: the river overflowed after the rain. Avoid the area, stay on upper floors and follow the instructions of the authorities. The road is blocked until further notice, do not cross on foot or by car.

Hi, the supermarket delivery person is at the gate with the groceries for flat 2. He has been waiting five minutes and cannot stay long. Do you want me to tell him he can leave them at the concierge or that he should come back later?

The fibre technician has arrived for flat 5A. He needs to enter the technical room in the basement. Please confirm in the app that you are expecting him, otherwise he will come back tomorrow morning between 9am and 12pm. Have a good day.
A visitor, Mr Bruno, is waiting at the entrance for flat 302. He says he was invited to dinner tonight. I cannot confirm without you, so I asked him to wait in the lobby. May I let him up?
Someone rang the entrance door bell. On the video a man in a yellow vest holds a parcel and waits at the gate. You can reply through the app, or leave the message and he will leave in a minute.
